The `options = !strip !debug` directive disables stripping and debugging symbols, which is typical for prebuilt binaries. No obfuscated URLs, suspicious downloads, or unexpected behaviors are present.

This file does not contain executable code or logic. It is a metadata file used by Arch Linux packaging tools and reflects standard, safe AUR practices. All sources are pinned to a specific release tag (1.2.55), and checksums are provided and match the expected format. There is no evidence of tampering, backdoors, or supply-chain attacks.
